result.topic_en: Calculations on the conformal mapping of the ellipsoid onto the sphere (latitude φ to ψ): the differential relation and second-order series expansion of s = sin φ in terms of σ = sin ψ, with eccentricity e.
result.transcription:
$\frac{(1-ee)d\varphi}{(1-ee\sin\varphi^2)\cos\varphi} = \frac{d\psi}{\cos\psi}$

$\frac{d\sigma}{1-\sigma\sigma} = \frac{(1-ee)ds}{(1-eess)1-ss}$

$\frac{ds}{d\sigma} = \frac{[-(1-ee)-](1-eess)(1-ss)}{(1-\sigma\sigma)(1-ee)}$ $1-(1+ee)ss+ees^4$

$\frac{d^2s}{d\sigma^2} = \left(\frac{1-ee}{1-\sigma\sigma}\right)^2 [4ees^3-2(1+ee)s](1-eess)(1-ss)$
$+\frac{2\sigma[-(1-ee)-](1-eess)(1-ss)}{(1-\sigma\sigma)^2}$

$2\sigma - eeb$ [?]
$-2(1+ee)s+4ees^3$

$\frac{2(1-ee)(1-eess)(1-ss)}{(1-\sigma\sigma)^2}\{\sigma-(1-e^4)s+2(ee-e^4)s^3\}$

$(4ees^3-2(1+ee)s)\frac{1-eess\,1-ss}{(1-ee)^2(1-\sigma\sigma^2)}$

$+\frac{(1-eess)(1-ss).2\sigma}{(1-\sigma\sigma)^2(1-ee)}$

$S+\frac{1-eeSS}{1-ee}\Delta S - \frac{2(1-eeSS)eeS}{(1-ee)^2}\Delta S^2$

$\frac{2(1-ss)(1-eess)}{(1-\sigma\sigma)^2(1-ee)^2}\left\{\begin{matrix}\sigma-\sigma ee\\ -s-see+2ees^3\end{matrix}\right\}$

$\sin\varphi-\sin\psi = \frac{ee\cos P^2}{1-ee}(\sin\psi-\sin P) - \frac{2(1-ee\sin P^2)ee\sin P}{(1-ee)^2}(\sin\psi-\sin P)^2$

methods.what: Differential equation of conformal mapping of ellipsoidal latitude φ onto spherical latitude ψ
Same relation in terms of s = sin φ and σ = sin ψ
Second derivative d²s/dσ² computed for Taylor expansion
Second-order Taylor series of s in powers of ΔS
Series for sin φ − sin ψ in powers of (sin ψ − sin P)
